assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via CPT 93271 is indicated
to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and guide appropriate anticoagulation therapy
consistent with the documented diagnosis codes I48.91 and Z86.73
